cohort: 485 pregnant women who delivered at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Clinical Centre of Vojvodina, Novi Sad, over a 3 year period
finding: Higher maternal BMI was significantly correlated with increased risk of arterial hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, preeclampsia, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: A statistically significant correlation was found between BMI and cesarean section.
